usageNotes: Use this to update node-level settings such as ACME certificate domains, wake-on-LAN configuration, boot delay for VMs/CTs, or the node's descriptive notes. Requires the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path (/), so a dedicated API token must be granted that role. Changes take effect immediately and the call returns null on success — use the digest parameter when making concurrent updates to prevent race conditions.

examples.summary: Set a node description and add a 30-second boot delay before guests start on reboot

params.description: Primary Proxmox hypervisor — Hetzner AX102, 64 GB RAM, NVMe pool.

tips: Send only the fields you want to change; omit all others — unset fields are not cleared.
To remove an optional setting (e.g. location or wakeonlan), pass its key name in the 'delete' parameter as a comma-separated string rather than sending an empty value.
The 'acmedomain[n]' parameter is indexed (acmedomain0, acmedomain1, …); each index maps to one SAN entry on the node's ACME-issued certificate.
ballooning-target is a node-level hint for the memory ballooning driver; tuning it does not restart running VMs.
Use get_nodes_node_config (GET /nodes/{node}/config) first to retrieve the current digest, then pass it here to guard against concurrent edits.
